book.name: 1 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Kweego muniege enye, kyeego enye woosi nikumweega Krisito.
Obhuzaabhi bhwo okusabha
Nirabhakumya kwe ekigirirye muranihiita mumangʼana goosi, no okugwaata ameegyo gano niabhaheeri.

Nawe bhoono ndeenda mumenye kubha obhukaangati bhwo omusubhe wowoosi bhurareka ku Krisito, no obhukaangati bhwo omukari bhurareka kumusubhe waaye, no obhukaangati bhwa Krisito bhurareka ku Taatabhugya.
Kweego, omusubhe wowoosi wuno akukuundikirya omutwe hano akusabha, kasi hano akuruusya obhurooti, wuyo aramusuukya Krisito, wuno niwe omukaangati waaye.

Neewe omukari wuno atakukuundikirya omutwe gwaaye hano akusabha, kasi hano akuruusya obhurooti, wuyo aramusuukya omusubhe waaye, wuno niwe omutwe gwaaye. Erabha ego, kwo okubha arabha kyo omukari wuno amwiiri oruhara.
Eraabhe omukari atakukuundikirya omutwe gwaaye, amwe eziinzweeri zyaaye! Nawe ni soni kwo omukari okumwa eziinzweeri zyaaye, kweego, hakiriku akuundikirye omutwe gwaaye.
Etakungʼarira kumusubhe okukuundikirya omutwe, kwo okubha ewe ni tuubho no obhuguungo bhwa Taatabhugya. Nawe omukari areerekya obhuguungo bhwo omusubhe waaye.
Niragaamba ego, kwe ekigirirye Taatabhugya atamubhuumbiri omusubhe okurwa kumukari, nawe akamubhuumba omukari okurwa kumusubhe.
Naabhe Taatabhugya atamubhuumbiri omusubhe kwiiguru yo omukari, nawe akamubhuumba omukari kwiiguru yo omusubhe.
Kwiiguru ya riyo, kweeki kwiiguru ya bhamaraika, omukari areenderwa okukuundikirya omutwe gwaaye, okweerekya kubha ari iyaasi yo obhukaangati bhwo omusubhe waaye.
Nawe kwo okugwaatana no Omukuru, omukari aramwiisiga omusubhe, neewe omusubhe ariisiga omukari.
Niragaamba ego, kwo okubha kyeego omukari yabhuumbirwe okurwa kumusubhe, niigo ego omusubhe woosi ariibhurwa no omukari. Nawe ebhigiro bhyoosi bhirarwa ku Taatabhugya.
Bhoono mwaamure abheene, ereenderwa omukari okumusabha Taatabhugya okutama kukuundikirya omutwe gwaaye?
Ndora naabhe emibhiri egyeene gireerekya kubha, ni soni kumusubhe kubha ne eziinzweeri taambi!
Nawe kumukari kubha ne eziinzweeri taambi kuramukora asuukwe,
kwe ekigirirye aheerwe eziinzweeri taambi okubha zibhe kyo omweenda gwo okukuundikirya omutwe.
Nawe eraabhe omuutu areenda kuhakana iguru ya amangʼana gayo, na amenye kubha etwe tutana nyaangi eziindi kukira ziyo, naabhe mumakanisa ga Taatabhugya zitariho nyaangi eziindi.
Enyaangi ye ebhyaakurya bhyo Omukuru
Ambe, mubhuswaagyo bhuno, nitakubhakumya, kwo okubha hano mukwiikumania mutakukora go obhweera, nawe murakora gano gatana obhweera.
Niigwiiri kubha, hano mukwiikumania mukanisa, kuno obhutwaanikani gati weenyu. Na neenye niriikirirya kusuuhu kubha niigo eri.
Obhutwaanikani bhureenderwa bhutuuke gatigati weenyu, okubha bhe eheene bhamenyekane.
Nawe, hano mukwiikumania hamwe mutakurya ebhyaakurya bhyo Omukuru kyeego ekweenderwa,
kwo obhugazuro omuutu wuyo woosi ararya ebhyaakurya bhyaaye okutama kuganya abhaandi. Kweego, abhaandi bharasaaga ne enzara, abhaandi bhagwaatirwe.

Bhoono, mutana nyuumba yino mukunagya okurya no okunywa? Kwaki murazeera abhaatu bha Taatabhugya no okubhasuukya bhano bhatana kigiro? Nibhabhuurireki? Nibhakumye? Zeyi! Nitakubhakumya kwiiguru ya amangʼana gayo.
Okurya ebhyaakurya bhyo Omukuru kyeego ekweenderwa
Ameegyo gano nikasuungʼaana okurwa ku Mukuru Yeesu, nigo gano niabhaheeri emwe kubha, obhutiku bhurya bhuno bhaamuriiri omukoonyo, akagega omukaate,
akamubhuurira, “Ozomirye, Taatabhugya,” akagubhega, akabhuga, “Guno nigwo omubhiri gwaane guno guraaruusibhwe kwiiguru weenyu. Mubhe murakora ego, kwo okunihiita enye.”
Egoego, hano bhaamariri kurya ebhyaakurya, akagega amaanzi go omuzabibu
mukikoombe, akabhuga, “Amaanzi go omuzabibu gano gariimeererera eriiragano
eriihya rino Taatabhugya akukora, kuhitira amanyiinga gaane. Hano mukunyweera ekikoombe kino, mubhe murakora ego, kwo okunihiita enye.”
Kweego, hano mukurya omukaate guyo no okunyweera ekikoombe kiyo, murabha muraraarika okukwa kwo Omukuru tee hano araaze.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akurya omukaate guyo kasi okunyweera ekikoombe kiyo kyeego etakweenderwa, arabha akoriri ebhibhi, arabha azeeriri omubhiri na amanyiinga go Omukuru.
Kweego, omuutu wowoosi yiisuunze omweene hiinga, niho arye omukaate no okunywa amaanzi go omuzabibu.
Niragaamba ego, kwo okubha omuutu wuno akurya omukaate no okunywa amaanzi go omuzabibu okutama okumenya kubha ano obhumwe no omubhiri gwo Omukuru, wuyo arabha yiitiniiri ekiina omweene.
Kiyo nikyo ekigirye gati weenyu bhariho abhanyookobhu na abharweeri bhaaru, na abhaandi bhakuuri.
Eraabhe tuungisuunziri abheene, Taatabhugya atiingatutiniiri ekiina.
Nawe bhoono, hano tukutinirwa ekiina no Omukuru, hayo turabha turakyoorwa, okubha Taatabhugya ataaza akatutinira ekiina kyeego akubhatinira abhaatu bhano bhatakumwiigwa ewe.
Kweego, abhahiiri bhaane, hano mukwiikumania okurya ebhyaakurya bhyo Omukuru, mwiiganye hiinga.
Eraabhe omuutu ane enzara, arye owaaye, okubha okwiikumania kweenyu kutabhakora okutinirwa ekiina. Amangʼana agaandi gano gasaagiri, hano nikuuza niragatuura kisi.

footnotes.text: Eriibhaga riyo ryaari ni soni kwo omukari okumwa oruhara.
Okweerekya kubha ari iyaasi yo obhukaangati bhwo omusubhe waaye, obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, okweerekya obhukaangati bhwaaye.
Eriibhaga riyo ryaari eziinyaangi kubhakari kutuga eziinzweeri.
a Amaanzi go omuzabibu. Rora amangʼana gano mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
b Eriiragano. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
